answer: Each bonded identity is a vertex in the consensus graph; when evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, the protocol charges P(k)=c k² against their escrows. A falcon monitor aggregates signed conflicts, while asymmetric depreciation applies a per-identity loss factor q>1 to detected swarm capital, yielding an additional q^k multiplier. Relic credentials do not evade linkage, so splitting stake across sybils cannot dilute the operator’s risk.
